{
  "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE key plate for the human of a silent animated film, shot s01, key K4 (awe, frame 104). A single full-length figure on a pure opaque black field, one thin pale baseline under the boots, and the cream label "K4" centered beneath that baseline. No other text, no props, no scenery, no bubble drawn.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the approved MODEL SHEET and the authority for exact character identity and proportions, especially cell 1. Image 2 is the approved rendering pick: match its line quality, tapered tips, flat identity pigments and stipple shadows. Do not reproduce either reference layout or its extra figures.
CHARACTER INVARIANTS: exact green skin, mauve-and-blue angular poncho with cream panels, one trailing swoop of cream-and-mauve hair, large hands, flared trousers and boots. About eight heads tall with long thin limbs. Preserve the model sheet's flat colours and identity pigments and thin pale contour about 1/166 of figure height. Match Image 2's delicate tapered contours and sparse stipple shadow.
COMPOSITION: full figure uncropped, occupying about 62 percent of total plate height, with generous black negative space.
